issue.title: Add interoperable BIP-329 wallet label import and export
issue.body:
Bitcoin Core wallets can manage address labels through RPCs such as `setlabel`, `getaddressesbylabel`, and `listlabels`, but they do not appear to support importing or exporting labels in the interoperable [BIP-329 JSON Lines format](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0329.mediawiki). This leaves users who move between compatible wallets to recreate metadata manually, even though labels can carry privacy-relevant context about transaction and address history.

Could Core add a BIP-329 import/export path for the record types its wallet can represent, with explicit handling for unsupported types and round-trip functional tests? This would complement existing wallet backup/migration while keeping the format's scope and compatibility limitations clear. The current label RPC surface is implemented in [`src/wallet/rpc/addresses.cpp`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/src/wallet/rpc/addresses.cpp); searches for BIP-329 support or an existing import/export proposal did not find an implementation or matching issue/PR.
